The [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Talan-De]] conducted a '''purifying ritual''' to protect people from the effects of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]]. The Mystic [[Ki-Da]] created this ritual. The ritual is conducted by taking a dark crystal from a cave in the [[Nightmare Lands]]; using the crystal to cleanse the corrupted Voss, trapping the darkness that drives them mad; and then finally taking the crystal to the ruins, placing it before the ancient tablets and meditating to gain Ki-Da's wisdom.
